tools.name: pm_market_brief
tools.description: The full report: exact fill and slippage for your size, total cost including fees and builder fee, the breakeven probability you need to believe, reward eligibility and payout estimate, net edge against your own probability estimate, and a verdict (operate / operate_partial / do_not_operate / insuff

tools.name: pm_platform_fee
tools.description: Exact taker fee for a Polymarket trade: shares x feeRate x p(1-p). Makers pay nothing on the global exchange. Also returns maker rebate, optional builder fee and the fee as a percentage of notional.

tools.name: pm_reward_eligibility
tools.description: Whether a resting order qualifies for a market's daily liquidity rewards (minimum size, maximum distance to midpoint), exactly what is missing if it does not, and an estimate of the daily payout.

tools.name: pm_order_book_fill
tools.description: Walks the order book level by level: VWAP, slippage in basis points against mid, what fills and what does not. Book arithmetic, not a fill-probability model.
